name: Crow Agents
author: crow
description: Background runs and Claude sessions from crow: slot gauge, attention badge, agents panel, run notifications.

command.label: Snapshot command
command.description: Prints the agents snapshot as JSON. Run with bash -lc; use an absolute path if crow is not on the login PATH.

watchCommand.label: Open crow watch
watchCommand.description: Launched by the panel's "open crow watch" button (bash -lc).

notifications.label: Run notifications
notifications.description: Toast when a background run finishes, fails or stops on the usage limit.

compactBelow.label: Compact below
compactBelow.description: When the bar is shorter than this (e.g. a vertical monitor), the pill shows only the slot gauge and the waiting badge. 0 = never compact.
